3. Launch with **Load Selected Mission Now (hotkey)**. Fight until at least one Skulking Sorcerer actually spawns and confirm the mission continues normally while fighting it.

4. Run `/ct_regression_test`, retain the complete report including the rank-eight health-backfill check, exit normally, and attach the newest console log. Identify the actual sorcerer encounter in the report.
assertions: The initialized curse's missing rank-8 health entry is restored to 150 without overwriting an existing value, and a real Skulking Sorcerer spawns and fights normally. The named check and full regression report pass, with no health-clamp failure or secondary missing-health hit-reaction crash.
